rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: An IP address search server built by SleepingBag945 that integrates SQLite database storage with Go-based tooling for IP address lookups and geolocation queries. The implementation uses the glebarez/go-sqlite driver for local data persistence and the mark3labs/mcp-go framework for protocol handling, providing a lightweight solution for IP address intelligence and network reconnaissance tasks. Useful for cybersecurity workflows, network analysis, threat intelligence gathering, and any application requiring fast local IP address resolution and geolocation data without external API dependencies.
